item.title: Wearable updates wait for fresher data
item.summary: Murph now favors next-day timing for supported wearable summaries and gives a clearer recovery step when Apple Health data is late.
item.details: Exact requested times and action-timed reminders stay unchanged. In a group, Murph names a participant only after consented shared status shows Apple Health is their sole connected source; missing data remains unknown rather than zero.

tryIt.label: Ask about missing Apple Health data
tryIt.prompt: My Apple Health sleep data for yesterday is missing in Murph. What should I check?
